extrait: '(0.1 + 0.2) + 0.3 == 0.1 + (0.2 + 0.3)'
reponse: 'FALSE'
attendu: "`TRUE`, addition is associative"

::: {.piege}
```{r}
(0.1 + 0.2) + 0.3 == 0.1 + (0.2 + 0.3)

sum(c(1e40, 1, -1e40))
sum(c(1e40, -1e40, 1))
```
:::

## Why

Every addition between decimals rounds its result to the nearest binary number. Changing the order of operations changes the intermediate roundings, and therefore sometimes the last bit of the total.

With very different orders of magnitude, the gap becomes visible: `1e40 + 1` cannot be represented, the 1 is absorbed, and it vanishes from the total. Sorting, filtering or merging the data before a `sum()` can thus change the result of what is otherwise the same calculation.

## The remedy

Never compare two totals down to the bit: compare with a tolerance.

::: {.piege}
```{r}
isTRUE(all.equal((0.1 + 0.2) + 0.3, 0.1 + (0.2 + 0.3)))
```
:::
